summary: Track AIPAC states Villegas recognizes the genocide in Gaza and has pledged to oppose military aid to Israel. CAIR Action endorsed him in the general election and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally. As a school board member in January 2024, he signed a public ceasefire letter to the Biden White House. His campaign platform opposes the Iran war as a 'reckless war of choice,' and pro-Israel PACs DMFI PAC and 314 Action Fund spent against him.
